title.zh: Visa’s $2.5 billion crypto credit bet puts card settlement financing onchain
title.en: Visa’s $2.5 billion crypto credit bet puts card settlement financing onchain

current_state.zh: Visa and Credit Coop have launched an onchain revolving stablecoin credit facility that funds daily card settlement obligations, reportedly financing $2.5 billion since 2023.
